Kadget Remote for Android — control your Mac running Kadget from your phone over Tailscale.

Install: download the APK on the phone and allow installing from this source. Then on the Mac open Kadget › Tools › Kadget Remote, turn it on and scan the code.

## Changes

- feat(camera): Kadget Camera joins Remote (frames, install row, info.cameraDevice, app auto-start); Kadget 3.13.0, Remote 1.12.0
- fix(remote-app): drop single-use locals in the camera page and lens switch
- fix(remote): resume a reconnecting phone camera without asking; camera.control on the camera's session
- fix(remote-app): camera controls run one at a time, reconnect and Camera2 errors end the camera, Kadget Camera hint
- feat(remote): phone screenshot to the Mac clipboard
- feat(remote-app): phone screenshots for the Mac
- fix(remote-app): camera survives plugin string throws, asks notifications, ends when the session gives up
- feat(remote-app): Camera page streams to the Mac
- fix(remote): ignore a camera.state that crosses the Mac's stop
- feat(remote): camera protocol, hub, ask and RTC slot
- feat(remote-app): camera and screenshot protocol, RTC camera kind
